Trout taking for Ova

27 | females | full & ready to spawn

13 | do | spent

6 | do | nearly spent

16 | do | not ready

105 | males | with milt

19 | do | spent

26 | Bright | in good condition

Memo: 1 of the males was full of milt though only two years old. 1 female was full of white or very pale eggs.

Henry Lee

I am very much obliged for your kindness in sending me the results about the sexes of Trout.— I am anxious to ascertain approximately the proportional numbers of the sexes in any animals; but there are so many causes of error that I fear I shall not succeed.

With my best thanks for your information I beg leave to remain | Dear Sir | Yours faithfully | Charles Darwin
